description:
How long people actually serve in Georgia, by offense and year: average
    sentence, years served, percentage of sentence served, share released on
    parole, and the lifer figures — plus the trend summary.

    `offense` is a case-insensitive substring of GDC's offense name (e.g. 'murder',
    'burglary', 'drug'; also the four-digit offense code). With no `offense` the
    all-crimes series is returned. `year` is the calendar year of release (e.g.
    '2023'). Both filter on this server. Rows are newest year first and paged:
    `limit` (default 30) and `offset`; `matched_offenses` lists what `offense`
    matched. `summary_only` returns just the summary block.
name: get_length_of_stay
title: Get length of stay
